reason: The cited evidence (E2, E3) shows W addition improves high-temperature wear resistance in AlCoCrFeNiWx coatings via lattice distortion and W-rich phases, but it does not demonstrate the claimed mechanism of catalyzing a continuous tribo-oxide glaze layer, nor does it provide data for room-temperature performance or for the CoCrFeNi (Al-free) matrix. E1 is about Nb and WC, not W, and is irrelevant to the key premises.
premises: W addition to CoCrFeNi induces strong lattice distortion
W addition nucleates W-rich secondary phases
W-rich phases catalyze formation of a continuous protective tribo-oxide glaze layer during sliding
The glaze layer reduces friction and wear from RT to 800 °C
0.5 at.% W is an effective concentration for this mechanism
